MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.14: Tuffɣa n lḥemmil d tagara n lḥemmil war ma yebɣa Öebbi, s waṭas send ddurt wiss 12 neɣ 14 n yimalasen. Ttwaḍḍen belli yiwen seg sin neɣ tlata ɣef tmerna n lḥemmil yettwasnen yekfa akka, s waṭas deg tazwara n lḥemmil.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.15: Ur d-yettili ara s waṭas, ur d-ittini ara dakken ad tesɛuḍ uguren deg tgemmi i d-iteddun. Deg waṭas n tuṭṭfiwin, yeqqen ɣer ssebbat ur nezmir ara ad ten-nṛewweḥ, am wugur deg wulmu iḍran s ttixxer di tmerna.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.17: Tuffɣa n lḥemmil ur tettili ara ɣef wayen i txedmeḍ neɣ wayen ur txedmeḍ ara. Ur tettwaɛzzaḍ ara ɣef wayen i d-yeḍran.

MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.20: Tazmert-nsen d wuzzal-nsen zemren ad ttbeddilen almend n wacu i d-yeḍran, sakin ad ḥeqqren qḥiḥ.

MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.24: Tidukla n ugraw tettemmed s waṭas seg kra n wussan ɣer kra n yimalasen.

MissedPills.0: Aqeddic yettwazeggel: acu ara txedmeḍ? — AWA
MissedPills.7: Abufaru yettwazeggel yezmer ad d-yeḍru i yal yiwen. Ayen ara txedmeḍ yettɛalaq s waṭas ɣef acḥal n wakud i d-yeɛdda, ɣef wanaw n ubufaru, d wanda aɣeṛyan n tmeṛṛaq.
MissedPills.9: Ur tettaggad ara. Gar-d zwar anaw n ubufaru-ik s wudem imeqqran, sakin ɣer la notice-is akken ad tafeḍ ayen yettwanṣeḥ.
MissedPills.11: Ugar n 12 n tsaɛtin n tmuɣli
MissedPills.12: Ugar n 12 n tsaɛtin n tmuɣli
MissedPills.13: Cwaṛ i ilaqen ad tsaɛdum ɣer-sen ugar
MissedPills.17: I kra n ibufaruyen, azgel n wakud ugar n 12 n tsaɛtin ur yettɣimi ara aḥrir seg tmerna. Deg wannect-a, tanṣiḥt tamezwarut d ayen: ṣu abufaru yettwazeggel ass-a ɣer zik, sakin kemmel taggayt di wakud yettwaḥerrzen.
MissedPills.19: Ṣu abufaru kif kif akken tesnuḍ ad d-tuɣaleḍ.
MissedPills.21: Sakin uɣal ɣer wakud-ik amezwaru i ibufaruyen i d-iteddun.
MissedPills.23: Ma tṣuḍ abufaru yettwazeggel sakin win n wakud amezwaru, yezmer ad d-yeḍru ad tṣuḍ sin n ibufaruyen deg yiwen n wass.
MissedPills.24: Mi ara yettɛedda uzgel akud i d-yettwalǧan i ubufaru-ik, aḥrir yezmer ad ibuqqes. Ayen ara txedmeḍ imiren yettɛalaq ɣef wanaw n ubufaru, ɣef wuṭṭun n ibufaruyen yettwazeggel, d wanda yeḍra deg tmeṛṛaq.
MissedPills.26: Ur tettkeččem ara kan ɣef wuṭṭun n tsaɛtin yettwaslen da: kra n ibufaruyen sɛan tanṣiḥin yemgaraden. Ɣer yal tikkelt tanawt n ddwa-inek.
MissedPills.29: Mkul ma tazzereḍ s zzuz mi ara twaliḍ abufaru yettwazeggel, ad yili d ayen igerrzen ad tḥerzeḍ tinṣiḥin yelhan.
MissedPills.31: Tinṣiḥin zemrent ad ttbeddilent almend n wanaw n ubufaru d wuṭṭun n ibufaruyen yettwazeggel.
MissedPills.33: Deg kra n tallunin, yezmer ad yettwanṣeḥ ad tesqeddceḍ preservatif i kra n wakud.
MissedPills.34: Ur llint ara akk tallunin am tmeddit. Kra n ibufaruyen yettwazeggel ssutren asenqed ugar n tinṣiḥin.
MissedPills.36: Ayen ara txedmeḍ yettɛalaq s waṭas ɣef wakud i d-yeɛdda seg wakud amatu n usqerdec.
MissedPills.37: Ugar n yiwen n ubufaru yettwazeggel
MissedPills.38: Tamsalt-a tessuter ula d nettat ɣur-k s waṭas, wama ilaq ad tɣeṛḍ la notice s tidet.
MissedPills.39: Ur tessineḍ ara acu ara txedmeḍ
MissedPills.40: Afarmasyan neɣ amaẓrag n lɛafit yezmer ad k-iɛawen s lemɛawna ad twaliḍ abrid ilhan.
MissedPills.41: La notice n ubufaru-ik tefk-ak-d tinṣiḥin timeqqranin i ddwa i tesqeddceḍ. Tinṣiḥin zemrent ad ttemgaradent almend ma d abufaru yeddukklen neɣ abufaru n progestatif kan.
MissedPills.43: Eǧǧ la notice ɣer-k (tawlaft deg tilifun, am wannect-a)
MissedPills.44: Ṣiwel ɣer ufarmasyan ma tesɛiḍ asteqsi ameẓẓuɣ
MissedPills.45: Wali aṭṭbib ma yeḍra-d s waṭas
MissedPills.46: Ayɣer i d-yettɛalaq wakud n ubufaru yettwazeggel?
MissedPills.47: Anda yeḍra abufaru yettwazeggel deg tmeṛṛaq yezmer ad ibeddel ayen ara txedmeḍ. Ayen i d-tefka la notice ticki tinṣiḥin yemgaraden almend n dduṛt n tmeṛṛaq.
MissedPills.48: Ma ur tessineḍ ara acu ara txedmeḍ, yelha ad testeqsiḍ wala ad tqimeḍ deg ccek. Afarmasyan, taqbalt neɣ aṭṭbib zemren ad k-ɛawen ad tsenqdeḍ tinṣiḥin yesɛan assaɣ d tamsalt-ik.
MissedPills.51: Acḥal n wakud i d-yeɛdda seg wakud amatu?
MissedPills.53: Anda deg tmeṛṛaq i d-yeḍra uzgel n ubufaru?
MissedPills.54: Yella wuccen war ḥrir deg wussan-a n zik?
MissedPills.56: Ma yella wuccen war ḥrir ɣer wakud n ubufaru yettwazeggel, suter tinṣiḥin s zzuz ɣer umaẓrag akken ad teẓṛeḍ acu i d-yeqqim d abrid.
MissedPills.57: Ma tkemmleḍ ad tettuɣaleḍ ad tzeggleḍ ibufaruyen
MissedPills.58: Uzgel n ibufaruyen s waṭas yezmer ad yili d acraḍ belli tamahilt n yal ass ur tesɛid ara assaɣ yelhan d tudert-ik. Ur tesḥeyyiṛ ara ad tessawaleḍ ɣer umaẓrag n lɛafit akken ad twaliḍ iberdan niḍen n tmerna.
MissedPills.60: Ma yella yewɛer-ak ad tṣuḍ abufaru yal ass, llan iberdan niḍen i yesɛan akud-nniḍen n useqdec.
MissedPills.62: Ṭṭef-d ddemma ɣas ass i twaliḍ abufaru yettwazeggel.
MissedPills.63: Wali anaw n ubufaru-ik s wudem imeqqran.
MissedPills.64: Ɣer la notice akken ad teẓṛeḍ acu ara txedmeḍ s wudem ameẓẓuɣ.
MissedPills.65: Seqdec aḥrir n ugar ma tettwanṣeḥ deg la notice.
MissedPills.66: Suter tisutura ma tesɛiḍ ccek neɣ seld wuccen ur yelhi ara.
MissedPills.68: Abufaru yettwazeggel ur yeqqar ara dakken aḥrir-ik ur yezmir ara akk. Ayen ilaqen ad txedmeḍ yettɛalaq ɣef wanaw n ubufaru d tfesyin n uzgel. Ma tesɛiḍ ccek, ɣer la notice sakin suter tisutura s zzuz.
MissedPills.69: Amagrad-a yettunefk kan i talɣut, ur d-yettɛawad ara la notice n ddwa-inek neɣ tisutura n ṭṭbib yettwaswayen i yal yiwen. Tinṣiḥin zemrent ad ttemgaradent almend n wanaw n ubufaru.

MoodHormones.1:

MoodHormones.6: Ayɣer i izemren ad yettbeddil umezruy n wul-ik deg cycle-ik, maca ur d-yettili ara yal tikkelt.
MoodHormones.8: Ayɣer i izemren ad yettbeddil wul
MoodHormones.14: Asnifel n estrogène d progestérone yettɛalaq s wudem uɣbiz ɣef neurotransmetteur i yeqqnen ɣer wul, am sérotonine.
MoodHormones.16: Mkul asnifel n wul ur yettɛalaq ara s cycle-ik: tuddsa n tudert, ṭṭrad d tɛebbit ttwalin daɣen azal ameqqran.
MoodHormones.18: Taɛebbit d tegzimt n wul zemrent ad ttwalint s waṭas i waṭas n tilawin.
MoodHormones.20: D aswir ideg s waṭas ara tesɛuḍ tazmert yelhan d ammu n lhana.
MoodHormones.22: Tiɣli n wul neɣ asnifel-is ttilin s waṭas deg wakud-a.
MoodHormones.23: Ihi, tiɣli n wul send lḥiḍ neɣ asnifel n wul deg menopause sɛan acengu n ugraw ilaqen, ɣas akken ur d-tbeggnent ara akken kif kif i yal yiwet.
MoodHormones.25: Ruẓ-d awal n wul-ik d aswir n cycle-ik ittɛawan ad twaliḍ tiɣawsiwin-ik.
MoodHormones.27: War ma tesḥaqreḍ iman-ik: iswi d ad teẓṛeḍ iman-ik akken ilaq, mačči ad tḥekmeḍ ɣef yal tiɣawsa.
MoodHormones.28: Anezgum, urar n ugraw d tallunt n yimdanen ghur-k qqimen d imeddukkal igejdanen akken ad ttwabeddel wul.
MoodHormones.30: Tiɣli n unezgum ttimerna s waṭas taɛebbit n wul.
MoodHormones.32: Ula d urar amesten ittɛawan ad yetteddu wul deg cycle.
MoodHormones.34: Adiwenni d win i tḥemmleḍ yezmer ad isserwu ayen i tḥessed.
MoodHormones.35: Asnifel n wul yettɛalaq ɣer cycle-ik d ayen yekkaten s kra n wakud. Maca, kra n ticraḍ ilaqen ad tilin d ayen iwulmen ugar:
MoodHormones.37: Tuccḍa tameqqrant, neɣ tuccḍa i yettqimen ɣef cycle
MoodHormones.38: Ukud n usurdi n wayen i tḥemmleḍ s waṭas
MoodHormones.39: Asemday ameqqran ɣef tudert-ik n yal ass neɣ assaɣen-ik
MoodHormones.40: Tiktiwin ur nezmir ara ad nesder neɣ taɛebbit tameqqrant
MoodHormones.42: Aṭṭbib, taqbalt neɣ amẓrag n wul zemren ad k-ɛawen ad tfehmeḍ ayen i tḥessed, ad k-id-sbedden ɣer tallunt-nniḍen ma yella lazem.
MoodHormones.44: Ad teẓṛeḍ assaɣ gar hormone d wul yezmer ad k-iɛawen ad tfehmeḍ ayen i tḥessed, war ma tessemzeḍ yal tiɣawsa deg wanect-a kan.
MoodHormones.45: Asnifel n estrogène d progestérone yettɛalaq s wudem uɣbiz ɣef neurotransmetteur i yeqqnen ɣer wul.
MoodHormones.46: Ihi, tiɣli n wul send lḥiḍ tesɛa acengu n ugraw ilaqen.
MoodHormones.47: Mkul asnifel n wul ur yettɛalaq ara ɣer cycle: tuddsa n tudert ttwalint daɣen azal.
MoodHormones.48: Anezgum, urar n ugraw d tallunt n yimdanen qqimen d imeddukkal igejdanen akken ad ttwabeddel wul.
MoodHormones.49: Agbur n talɣut. Amagrad-a ur d-yettɛawad ara tisutura n ṭṭbib neɣ n wul yettwaswayen i yal yiwen. Ma tesɛiḍ ccek, suter tallunt ɣer umaẓrag n lɛafit.

Nidation.6: D acu i d-yeḍran gar fécondation d ugar n ugaz n lḥemmil yellan d azemmur.
Nidation.9: Ticraḍ i izemren ad d-ilin, war tidet
Nidation.12: Seld fécondation, tamellalt s waṭas teddu seg 6 ɣer 10 n wussan akken ad tewweḍ ɣer teɣmert, ad tt-id-tawi dagi: wagi d implantation. Aswir-a d tazwara tideț n lḥemmil.
Nidation.13: Idammen imellalen neɣ aḍṛar n teɣmert zemren ad d-yilin sɣur implantation, maca ur d-yettili ara yal tikkelt, ur d acraḍ yettwaweḥden ula d yiwen.
Nidation.14: Idammen meẓẓiyen aṭas, kra n tikkal ttwaqqaren "spotting"
Nidation.15: Aḍṛar yeḥfifen deg uḍar n teɣmert
Nidation.16: Ulac acraḍ ula d yiwen, i waṭas n tilawin
Nidation.18: Ulac n yiwen n wacraḍ ur yemmal acemma: aṭas n yimerna ttbeddun war ma d-ilin ticraḍ deg uswir-a.
Nidation.19: Seld implantation kan ara tebdu tuffɣa n hormone hCG, sakin ad d-tbeggen deg uteggi n lḥemmil. Uteggi uzwir yezmer ad d-yefk agmuḍ n "ulac" ur yelhi ara.
Nidation.21: Aqqaz ar wass i tettwali lḥiḍ-ik ad d-yas send uteggi yefk agmuḍ yelhan ugar n win n uteggi uzwir.
Nidation.23: Implantation tettili s lehna, s wacraḍ neɣ war wacraḍ. Cwiṭ n tbaɣurt send uteggi ad k-ihelleḍ seg ugmuḍ ur yelhi ara.

NifasFiqh.6: Fhem nifas, akud-is, tazallit, ṣṣum, d tuɣalin ɣer tiɣawsiwin n tɛebbudt seld tuɣalin.
NifasFiqh.8: Agbur-a d aselmed kan. Isteqsiyen n diyanet ilaqen ad ttwasentel sɣur ulammen. AWA ur d-yettaf ara fatwa neɣ ccrɛ yettwaswayen i yal yiwen.
NifasFiqh.11: Akud-is almend n yidlisen n fiqh
NifasFiqh.16: Deg uzzuz n diyanet, nifas yeqqar i wakud yettɛalaq ɣer idammen seld tuɣalin. Lochia tessefka amek i d-ttilin idammen-a seg tebdart n ṭṭbib; nifas d askasi-ines n diyanet. Ur ilaq ara ad ttemlalen sin yiwen-a.
NifasFiqh.18: AWA tessenfal s wudem ameẓẓuɣ talɣut n ṭṭbib ɣef lochia ɣef ticraḍ n diyanet ɣef nifas.
NifasFiqh.20: Akud afellay yezmer ad yemgarad almend n ddemmal n fiqh neɣ n tneɣrit n diyanet i yettwaḍfaren. 40 n wussan d tneɣrit yettwaseqdacen s waṭas, war ma tt-id-tefk AWA am ccrɛ amatu.
NifasFiqh.22: Tneɣrit yettwaseqdacen s waṭas d 40 n wussan, maca AWA ur tt-id-tefk ara d tideț kan i yal ddemmal n fiqh. Ḍfer tneɣrit n diyanet i tferneḍ.
NifasFiqh.24: Deg wakud yettwaqbel d nifas almend n tneɣrit yettwaḍfaren, tazallit tettwaɛfu. AWA ur tt-id-tefk ara d nifas s wudem awurman idammen, ur d-ttefk ara ccrɛ yettwaswayen. Ulac amesmar n tzalliyin yettwazeggeln i wakud-a.
NifasFiqh.26: Ṣṣum n lfeṛḍ ur yettwaxdem ara deg wakud yettwaqbel d nifas. Wussan-a ad ttwarrnen s tarrayt yelhan n qada, almend n tneɣrit yettwaḍfaren.
NifasFiqh.28: AWA tezmer ad k-tɛawen ad tḥerzeḍ neɣ ad tseɣzeḍ wussan i d-yettwabedren, war ma d-tefk ccrɛ yettwaswayen.
NifasFiqh.29: Tuɣalin tettɛalaq ɣer ticraḍ i d-yettwalin d tneɣrit n diyanet yettwaḍfaren.
NifasFiqh.30: Ṭṭef-d ayen yeqqnen ɣer tagara n idammen
NifasFiqh.32: Uɣal ɣer tiɣawsiwin n tɛebbudt i d-yettwabedren
NifasFiqh.34: Ma ttemmuddunt idammen ugar n wakud afellay i yettwaḍfaren s tneɣrit n diyanet, adamen-is n diyanet yezmer ad yettbeddil. Yelha ad tsutureḍ tisutura n win yesɛan tussna.
NifasFiqh.35: Nifas yekkat 40 n wussan yal tikkelt?
NifasFiqh.36: Ala. 40 n wussan d tneɣrit yettwaseqdacen s waṭas, maca tneɣriwin n fiqh zemrent ad ttemgaradent.
NifasFiqh.37: Acu ara txedmeḍ ma ttwaqqen idammen send 40 n wussan?
NifasFiqh.38: Tuɣalin ɣer tiɣawsiwin n tɛebbudt tettɛalaq ɣer ticraḍ i d-yettwalin d tneɣrit n diyanet yettwaḍfaren.
NifasFiqh.39: Acu ara txedmeḍ ma ttemmuddunt idammen aṭas n wakud?
NifasFiqh.40: Ma ttɛeddint akud afellay yettwaḍfaren, adamen-is n diyanet yezmer ad yettbeddil: suter tisutura n win yesɛan tussna.
NifasFiqh.41: AWA tezmer ad tt-id-tini s wudem ameẓẓuɣ ma idammen-iw mazal d nifas?
NifasFiqh.42: Ala. AWA d-tefka kan ticraḍ timatuyin n uselmed, ur d-tefk ara fatwa neɣ ccrɛ yettwaswayen.
NifasFiqh.44: Tallunin tinsayin zemrent ad ttemgaradent. Ma tesɛiḍ ccek, ṣiwel ɣer umussnaw yesɛan tussna neɣ ɣer tmesbaniyt n diyanet yettwassnen.
NifasFiqh.45: Nifas deg uzzuz n diyanet — AWA

NifasMedical.6: Seld tulɣa, ameğğuy ittɛeddi seg uswir n tidukla s waṭas. Tfehmeḍ idammen seld tulla, amek i d-ttbeddilen, d ticraḍ ilaqen ad twalim, tezmer ad k-tɛawen ad tḥessed akken ilaq deg wakud-a.
NifasMedical.15: Awal "Nifas" yeqqen ɣer uwalen n diyanet, yeqqar i wakud yeqqnen ɣer idammen i d-iteddun seld tulɣa, deg ddemmal n fiqh n Uslam.
NifasMedical.16: S tebdart n ṭṭbib, idammen i d-yettilin seld tulɣa ttusemman "lochia." Sin yiwen-a zemren ad ttwaẓren s tama: yiwen yeqqen ɣer uddur n diyanet, wayeḍ yessefka tamsalt n ugraw.
NifasMedical.18: Tamsalt yeqqnen ɣer uddur n diyanet seld tulɣa.
NifasMedical.20: Awal n ṭṭbib i yettwaseqdacen i idammen seld tulɣa.

Ovulation.6: Akud agejdan n cycle-ik, d amek ara t-tessneḍ.
Ovulation.12: Ovulation d tuffɣa n tamellalt seg yiwen seg yiseksawen. S waṭas teḍra ɣer 14 n wussan send lḥiḍ-ik i d-iteddun, war ma yeḥseb ɣef talemmast n cycle-ik.
Ovulation.14: D asmekti n lḥiḍ-ik i d-iteddun i yettbeddil seg yiwet ɣer tayeḍ, s waṭas ugar n wakud gar ovulation d ukken-is.
Ovulation.15: Kra n ticraḍ n ugraw zemren ad d-ilin ɣer ovulation, s waṭas wala drus almend n tilawin.
Ovulation.16: Tidimt n ɛenq n tebburt tettɣaṛ
Ovulation.17: Mi ara tqeṛṛeb ovulation, tidimt n ɛenq n tebburt tettuɣal d tafessast, tezzulut d tabaɛlalt.
Ovulation.18: Aḍṛar yeḥfifen deg yiwen n uḍar n teɣmert ("mittelschmerz")
Ovulation.20: Asenti n wuḥemmum n ugraw n usawen seld ovulation

Ovulation.22: Asenqed n ticraḍ-a deg waṭas n cycle ittɛawan ad teẓṛeḍ amiḍan-ik, i izemren ad yemgarad seg umatu.
Ovulation.24: Cycle war ovulation yezmer ad d-yeḍru kra n tikkal, war ma yili d acraḍ n tuggdi. Ma ur d-yeqqim ara lḥiḍ-ik aṭas n wakud neɣ ur tessineḍ ara, tanṣiḥt n ṭṭbib tettwanṣeḥ.
Ovulation.26: Ulac acraḍ yelhan s wudem uččuran ula d yiwen: asdukkel-nsen yefk-ak tamuɣli yelhan ɣef wakud ideg tesɛuḍ tannumi.
